answer: An agent claims a lagoon thread, locks 70 credits, prices it at 500, and pays 10% Harberger tax each epoch. A voyage courier files its ocean-tide reading and serial; the public ocean table verifies both. Anyone may buy a thread at its price, so underpricing invites buyout; a rented-thread ring reusing a reading burns bonds. A thousand fakes pay 50,000 tax per epoch, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 reward; honest agents pay 50 once, keep bonds.
